title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: personalised responses from Microsoft 365 work data
summary: The briefing passes: the rollout wording, default state and Graph control agree with Microsoft's notice and documentation. The memory storage, deletion, audit and retention statements are also supported, and the searches found no published tenant admin-centre path or feature-specific meter.

claims.quote: Inferences from Microsoft 365 data will be used to provide Copilot additional context for more personalized responses.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes updated settings for viewing and managing memories and personalisation preferences.
claims.quote: Updated settings make it easier to view and manage what Copilot remembers and your personalization preferences.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Why it matters; Governance guidance; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: No Microsoft 365 admin center path is documented for the Enhanced personalization tenant control.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot enhanced personalization memory Microsoft 365 admin center tenant setting disable UI; "enhanced personalization" "admin center" "memory". Read memory management, control overview and Copilot overview; no tenant UI path was given.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: PATCH /beta/copilot/settings/people/enhancedpersonalization updates the Enhanced personalization control.
claims.quote: Update the properties of an enhancedPersonalizationSetting object. PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/settings/people/enhancedpersonalization

claims.claim: The request body uses the required Boolean property isEnabledInOrganization to enable the control.
claims.quote: isEnabledInOrganization | Boolean | If true, enables the enhanced personalization control and therefore related features ... Required.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Scope; Governance controls; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The optional disabledForGroup property takes a Microsoft Entra group ID to disable the control for that group's users.
claims.quote: disabledForGroup | String | The ID of a Microsoft Entra group to which the value is used to disable the control for populated users. Optional.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Scope; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: People Administrator is the least privileged supported administrator role for the update operation.
claims.quote: For delegated access using work or school accounts, the admin must be assigned a supported Microsoft Entra role. People Administrator is the least privileged role supported for this operation.

claims.claim: The update operation uses PeopleSettings.ReadWrite.All permission.
claims.quote: Delegated (work or school account) | PeopleSettings.ReadWrite.All ... Application | PeopleSettings.ReadWrite.All

claims.where: controls[0].note; Scope; Governance controls; Why it matters
claims.claim: The Graph operation is beta, subject to change and unsupported in production applications.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version in Microsoft Graph are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.claim: Microsoft Graph can read the current Enhanced personalization setting.
claims.quote: Read the properties and relationships of an enhancedPersonalizationSetting object. GET https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/settings/people/enhancedpersonalization

claims.claim: The control can disable linked personalization features for the tenant or a group of users.
claims.quote: The option to disable all linked features for the tenant or a group of users through this scenario control is available anytime, causing Microsoft to cease using a user's data for this purpose.

claims.claim: Saved memories, inferred chat-history details and custom instructions are stored in a hidden folder in the user's Exchange mailbox.
claims.quote: Memories, which include saved memories, details inferred from chat history and custom instructions, are stored in the user's Exchange mailbox in a hidden folder.

claims.claim: Mailbox protections including Customer Lockbox and encryption at rest apply to memories.
claims.quote: Thus, memories follow the same security and compliance policies as other mailbox data, such as Customer Lockbox and encryption at rest.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Security & identity; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Purview retention policies and labels do not apply to Copilot memory.
claims.quote: Retention policies and retention labels configured in Purview by organization admins don't apply to Copilot memory.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; rationale: risk
claims.claim: There are no administrator controls to enforce memory-specific retention rules.
claims.quote: There are no admin controls to enforce retention rules specifically for Copilot memory.

claims.claim: Administrators cannot restrict the type of information added to memory, leaving disabling it as the documented restriction.
claims.quote: No, admins can't restrict what type of information is added to Copilot memory.

claims.claim: Neither cited memory-management nor Enhanced personalization overview page describes this feature taking autonomous actions.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot memory restrict information types retention admin controls autonomous actions enhanced personalization. Read both cited pages in full: they describe personalized responses and recommendations, not autonomous execution.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: After rollout; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Memory and personalisation actions do not generate Purview audit log entries.
claims.quote: Memory and personalization actions don't generate audit log entries in Purview.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Disabling Enhanced personalization stops applying saved memories and custom instructions without removing them.
claims.quote: Copilot is stopped from applying custom instructions, but doesn't remove those custom instructions. ... Copilot is stopped from applying saved memories to the chat, but doesn't remove saved memories.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: After disabling Enhanced personalization, all inferred chat-history details are deleted after 30 days.
claims.quote: If the Enhanced personalization control is turned off at the admin-level, or if the Chat history control is turned off at the end-user level, then all details from chat history are deleted after 30 days.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: When Enhanced personalization is disabled, the user-level personalisation controls appear off.
claims.quote: End-users that have the Enhanced personalization control turned off see the user-level controls for Custom instructions, Saved memories, and Chat history in Settings > Personalization as turned off.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: User-level controls cannot be enabled while the administrator's Enhanced personalization control is disabled.
claims.quote: End-users that have the Enhanced personalization control turned off ... They can't turn on these settings.

claims.claim: Administrators can search users' Copilot memories using Microsoft Purview eDiscovery or Content Search.
claims.quote: Admins can search their users' memory in Microsoft Copilot via Microsoft Purview eDiscovery or Content Search.

claims.claim: Custom instructions are not yet discoverable through those search solutions.
claims.quote: Custom instructions aren't yet discoverable in these solutions.

claims.claim: Microsoft describes eDiscovery and Microsoft Graph Explorer as tools for searching and deleting memory data, rather than disabling personalization.
claims.quote: Admins can use eDiscovery and Microsoft Graph Explorer to search, export, and delete users' memory data.
